#Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

#to make the renv intially
#renv::init()

#renv friendly loading of packages.
#dont use pacman for this as it may overwrite the version of the package used in renv
required_packages <- c("knitr","tidyverse", "here", "renv","Hmisc","brms","mice","gtsummary","posterior","marginaleffects","bayestestR")

missing <- required_packages[!sapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop("Missing packages: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), 
       ". Please run renv::restore() to install them.")
}
#if a package isnt installed in renv::restore(), do this: 
#renv::install("tidyverse")

library(renv)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(Hmisc)
library(brms)
library(mice)
library(gtsummary)
library(posterior)
library(marginaleffects)
library(bayestestR)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

#functions
#convergence function - to see the model convergence diagnostics for each imputation
convergence <- function(chains=4,imps=20,mod=mod){
  draws <- as_draws_array(mod)
  # Subset chains for each dataset
  draws_per_dat <- lapply(1:imps, \(i) {
    start_chain <- (i - 1) * chains + 1
    end_chain <- i * chains
    subset_draws(draws, chain = start_chain:end_chain)
  })
  summaries <- lapply(draws_per_dat, summarise_draws, default_convergence_measures())
  return(summaries)
}

```

# Analysis phase 1

##Read in the data
```{r}
breast <- readRDS(here("Data","breast.RDS"))
breast_imp <- readRDS(here("Data","breast_imp.RDS"))
breast_split <- split(x=breast_imp,f=breast_imp$.imp)

```

los = los
pca device = assess_pca
meals = assess_meals_eaten
snacks = snacks_hosp
fluids = assess_liquid
time out of bed = minutes_out_of_bed
time spent moving = minutes_walking_moving
times walked = assess_walk_num
times physio = assess_exercises
how to enhance own recovery = assess_understand_enhance.factor
QOR = sum of qors

Have enough iterations + strong enough prior to get ~10000 draws in ess bulk and tail. (recommended for pulling out the 95% credible interval)

##LOS

```{r}
los_mod <- brm_multiple(los ~ treatment + surgery_type.factor,
                        data=breast_split,family=poisson,
                        iter=10000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,10),class=b),
                                  prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))
los_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=los_mod)
#los_summary <- summary(los_mod)
#p(sup)
los_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(los_mod)[2,3:4]
#rate ratio
losh <- hypothesis(los_mod,"treatment1 < 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
losrr <- merge(los_ci,losh) %>%
   mutate(RR = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(exp(Estimate),2))," (", round(exp(CI_low),2),", ",round(exp(CI_high),2),")"))
```

### LOS PP only

All control and per protocol participants in treatment
```{r}
breast_pp <- breast_imp %>% filter(treatment == "0" | per_protocol == 1)

los_mod <- brm_multiple(los ~ treatment + surgery_type.factor,
                        data=breast_pp_split,family=poisson,
                        iter=10000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,10),class=b),

#p(sup)
los_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(los_mod)[2,3:4]

   mutate(RR = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(exp(Estimate),2))," (", round(exp(CI_low),2),", ",round(exp(CI_high),2),")"))
```

##PCA device

```{r}
dev_mod <- brm_multiple(assess_pca ~ treatment + surgery_type.factor,data=breast_split,
                        family=bernoulli,iter=25000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,10),class="b"),
                                  prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))
dev_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=dev_mod)

#model results
dev_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(dev_mod)[2,3:4]
devh <- hypothesis(dev_mod,"treatment1 > 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
devor <- merge(dev_ci,devh) %>%
  mutate(OR = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(exp(Estimate),2))," (", round(exp(CI_low),2),", ",round(exp(CI_high),2),")"))
#crude and combine
crude_dev <- tbl_summary(data=breast,by="treatment",include="assess_pca",missing="no",
                           statistic = list(all_dichotomous() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)")) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 = "{level}",stat_2 = "{level}") %>%
  as.data.frame()
dev_res <- merge(crude_dev,devor)
saveRDS(dev_res,here("Output","Br_dev_res.RDS"))
```

##Snacks

```{r}
breast_snacks <- breast_imp %>% 
  mutate(snacks_hosp = factor(snacks_hosp,ordered=TRUE,
                              levels=c("0","1","2","3")))
breast_snacks <- split(x=breast_snacks,f=breast_snacks$.imp)

snacks_mod <- brm_multiple(snacks_hosp ~ treatment + surgery_type.factor,data=breast_snacks,
                        family=cumulative(link = "logit", threshold = "flexible"),
                        iter=15000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,10),class="b"),
                                  prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))
snacks_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=snacks_mod)
# 
# #getting a mean difference out of the ordinal model
# sims <- bind_rows(snacks_mod[["fit"]]@sim[["samples"]])
# intercepts_samps <- as.matrix(sims[grep("b_Intercept", names(sims))])
# E_Y_given_X0 <- rowSums(plogis(intercepts_samps))
# #treatment
# beta_trt_samps <- sims[["b_treatment1"]]
# # Compute expected probabilities for different treatment
# E_Y_given_X1 <- rowSums(plogis(intercepts_samps + beta_trt_samps))

#model results
snacks_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(snacks_mod)[2,3:4]
snacksh <- hypothesis(snacks_mod,"treatment1 > 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
snacksor <- merge(snacks_ci,snacksh) %>%
  mutate(OR = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(exp(Estimate),2))," (", round(exp(CI_low),2),", ",round(exp(CI_high),2),")"))
#crude and combine
crude_snacks <- tbl_summary(data=breast,by="treatment",include="snacks_hosp",missing="no",
                            statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)")) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 = "{level}",stat_2 = "{level}") %>%
  as.data.frame()
snacks_res <- merge(crude_snacks,snacksor)
saveRDS(snacks_res,here("Output","Br_snacks_res.RDS"))

```

##Fluids

```{r}
fluids_mod <- brm_multiple(assess_liquid ~ treatment + surgery_type.factor,data=breast_split,
                        family=gaussian,iter=10000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,1000),class="b"),
                                  prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))
fluids_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=fluids_mod)

#model results
fluids_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(fluids_mod)[2,3:4]
fluidsh <- hypothesis(fluids_mod,"treatment1 > 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
fluidsmd <- merge(fluids_ci,fluidsh) %>%
  mutate(MD = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(Estimate,2))," (", round(CI_low,2),", ",round(CI_high,2),")"))
#crude and combine
crude_fluids <- tbl_summary(data=breast,by="treatment",include="assess_liquid",missing="no",
                            type = list(assess_liquid ~ "continuous"),
                            statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({N_nonmiss}, {sd})"),
                            digits = all_continuous() ~ list(mean = 2, sd = 2, N_nonmiss = 0)
                           ) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 = "{level}",stat_2 = "{level}") %>%
  as.data.frame()
fluids_res <- merge(crude_fluids,fluidsmd)
saveRDS(fluids_res,here("Output","Br_fluids_res.RDS"))
```

```{r}
  mutate(how_bin = case_when(assess_understand_enhance.factor %in% c("A","SA") ~ 1,
                             assess_understand_enhance.factor %in% c("N","D","SD") ~ 0)) %>%
tbl_summary(by="treatment",include="how_bin",missing="no",
                           statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}/{N} ({p}%)")) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 = "{level}",stat_2 = "{level}") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(`**Characteristic**` = "how_bin") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`1`))
# how_res <- merge(crude_how)
saveRDS(how_res,here("Output","Br_how_res.RDS"))

```

##QOR

```{r}
qor_mod <- brm_multiple(qor_tot ~ treatment + surgery_type.factor,data=breast_split,
                        family=gaussian,iter=10000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,1000),class="b"),
                                  prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))
qor_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=qor_mod)

#model results
qor_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(qor_mod)[2,3:4]
qorh <- hypothesis(qor_mod,"treatment1 > 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
qormd <- merge(qor_ci,qorh) %>%
  mutate(MD = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(Estimate,2))," (", round(CI_low,2),", ",round(CI_high,2),")"))
#crude and combine
crude_qor <- tbl_summary(data=breast,by="treatment",include="qor_tot",missing="no",
                         digits = all_continuous() ~ list(mean = 2, sd = 2, N_nonmiss = 0),
                         statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({N_nonmiss}, {sd})")) %>%
  modify_header(stat_1 = "{level}",stat_2 = "{level}") %>%
  as.data.frame()
qor_res <- merge(crude_qor,qormd)
saveRDS(qor_res,here("Output","Br_qor_res.RDS"))

```

##Combine

```{r}
#the results
los_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_los_res.RDS"))
dev_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_dev_res.RDS"))
meal_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_meal_res.RDS"))
snacks_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_snacks_res.RDS"))
fluids_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_fluids_res.RDS"))
oob_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_oob_res.RDS"))
move_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_move_res.RDS"))
walk_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_walk_res.RDS"))
phys_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_phys_res.RDS"))
how_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_how_res.RDS"))
qor_res <- readRDS(here("Output","Br_qor_res.RDS"))
los_pp_res <- readRDS(here("Output","br_los_pp.RDS"))

res_models <- bind_rows(los_res,dev_res,meal_res,snacks_res,fluids_res,
                        oob_res,move_res,walk_res,phys_res,how_res,qor_res,
                        los_pp_res) %>%
  filter(`**Characteristic**` != "Unknown") %>%
  rename(char = `**Characteristic**`) %>%
  mutate(est = case_when(!is.na(RR) ~ paste0("RR = ",RR),
                         !is.na(OR) ~ paste0("OR = ",OR),
                         !is.na(MD) ~ paste0("MD = ",MD)),
         outcome = case_when(char == "los" ~ "Length of stay (median (N, IQR))",
                             grepl("device",char) ~ "PCA device used (n/N %)",
                             grepl("meals",char) ~ "3 Meals eaten (n/N %)",
                             grepl("SNACKS",char) ~ "Snacks eaten (n/N %)",
                             grepl("CUPS",char) ~ "Cups liquid consumed (mean (N, SD))",
                             grepl("minutes out of bed",char) ~ "Time out of bed (mean (N, SD))",
                             grepl("walking or moving",char) ~ "Time spent moving (mean (N, SD))",
                             grepl("walk for at least",char) ~ "Times walked (median (N, IQR))",
                             grepl("physio exercises",char) ~ "Times performed physio exercises (median (N, IQR))",
                             char == "how_bin" ~ "Understand how to enhance own recovery (n/N %)",
                             char == "qor_tot" ~ "QOR at 2 days (mean (N, SD))",
                             char == "lospp" ~ "Length of stay - per protocol (median (N, IQR))")) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome,`1`,`0`,est,Post.Prob)

saveRDS(res_models,here("Output","Br_res_models.RDS"))

```

# Analysis phase 2

## Read in the data

```{r}
br_p2_imp <- readRDS(here("Data","br_p2_imp.RDS")) %>%
   mutate(surgery_final = case_when(surgery_type.factor %in% c("Mastectomy and delayed reconstruction","Mastectomy - no reconstruction") ~ 1,
                                   surgery_type.factor == "Mastectomy and immediate reconstruction" ~ 0))

br_p2_split <- split(x=br_p2_imp,f=br_p2_imp$.imp)

br_p2 <- readRDS(here("Data","br_p2.RDS"))
```


## EORTC QLQ-C30 (30 & 90 days)

```{r}
#Make baseline a separate variable
eortc_base <- br_p2_imp %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor == "Baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(summary_score,record_id,.imp) %>%
  rename(base_summary = summary_score)
eortc <- br_p2_imp %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor != "Baseline") %>%
  left_join(eortc_base, by=c("record_id",".imp"))
eortc_split <- split(x=eortc,f=eortc$.imp)


#run the model
eortc_mod <- brm_multiple(summary_score ~ base_summary + surgery_type.factor +
                           treatment*redcap_event_name.factor + (1|record_id),
                           data=eortc_split,
                           family=skew_normal,iter=16000,seed=46137112,
                           control = list(adapt_delta = 0.995),
                           prior = c(prior(normal(0,1000),class="b"),
                                     prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept),
                                     prior(cauchy(0,100),class=sigma)))

#for sensitivity, do n(0,100) and n(0,10000)
#assess risk of overfitting
loo_res <- loo(eortc_mod)
#loo_res_dich <- loo(eortc_mod_dich)

#n(0,100) neglibigle difference, same with n(0,10000)
summary(eortc_mod)
eortc_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=eortc_mod) %>% bind_rows()

#get the CrI and Pr(Sup) from the models
eortch <- hypothesis(eortc_mod,c("treatment1 > 0",
                                 "treatment1 + treatment1:redcap_event_name.factor3monthfup > 0"),
                     alpha=0.025)[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Hypothesis,Estimate,Post.Prob,CI.Lower,CI.Upper) %>%
  mutate(redcap_event_name.factor = case_when(grepl("3month",Hypothesis) ~ "3 month fup",
                          .default="1 month fup"),
         MD = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(Estimate,2))," (", round(CI.Lower,2),", ",round(CI.Upper,2),")"))

#get the crude measures and combine
eortc_res <- br_p2 %>% 
  group_by(redcap_event_name.factor,treatment) %>% 
  summarise(summary_score = paste0(round(mean(summary_score,na.rm=T),2)," (",sum(!is.na(summary_score)),", ",round(sd(summary_score,na.rm=T),2),")")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=redcap_event_name.factor,names_from=treatment,values_from=summary_score) %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor != "Admission") %>%
  full_join(eortch,by="redcap_event_name.factor")

saveRDS(eortc_res,here("Output","br_p2_eortc.RDS"))
```


## HADS (Anxiety)  (30 & 90 days)

```{r}
#Make baseline a separate variable
hads_base <- br_p2_imp %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor == "Baseline") %>%
  dplyr::select(hads_anxiety,record_id,.imp) %>%
  rename(base_hads = hads_anxiety)
hads <- br_p2_imp %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor != "Baseline") %>%
  left_join(hads_base, by=c("record_id",".imp"))
hads_split <- split(x=hads,f=hads$.imp)

#run the model
hads_mod <- brm_multiple(hads_anxiety ~ surgery_type.factor + base_hads + treatment*redcap_event_name.factor + (1|record_id),
                         data=hads_split,
                         family=gaussian,iter=14000,seed=46137112,
                         control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                         prior = c(prior(normal(0,1000),class="b"),
                                   prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept),
                                   prior(cauchy(0,100),class=sigma)))

#sensitivity n(0,100) negligible difference, same with n(0,10000)
hads_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=hads_mod) %>% bind_rows()
summary(hads_mod)

#get the CrI and Pr(Sup) from the models
hadsh <- hypothesis(hads_mod,c("treatment1 < 0",
                                 "treatment1 + treatment1:redcap_event_name.factor3monthfup < 0"),
                    alpha=0.025)[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Hypothesis,Estimate,Post.Prob,CI.Lower,CI.Upper) %>%
  mutate(redcap_event_name.factor = case_when(grepl("3month",Hypothesis) ~ "3 month fup",
                          .default="1 month fup"),
         MD = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(Estimate,2))," (", round(CI.Lower,2),", ",round(CI.Upper,2),")"))

#get the crude measures and combine
hads_res <- br_p2 %>% 
  group_by(redcap_event_name.factor,treatment) %>% 
  summarise(hads_anxiety = paste0(round(mean(hads_anxiety,na.rm=T),2)," (",sum(!is.na(hads_anxiety)),", ",round(sd(hads_anxiety,na.rm=T),2),")")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=redcap_event_name.factor,names_from=treatment,values_from=hads_anxiety) %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor != "Admission") %>%
  full_join(hadsh,by="redcap_event_name.factor")

saveRDS(hads_res,here("Output","br_p2_hads.RDS"))

```


## QOR (2, 30 & 90 days)

```{r}
#run the model
qor_mod <- brm_multiple(qor_tot ~ surgery_type.factor + redcap_event_name.factor*treatment + (1|record_id),data=br_p2_split,
                        family=gaussian,iter=14000,seed=46137112,
                        prior = c(prior(normal(0,1000),class="b"),
                                  prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept),
                                  prior(cauchy(0,100),class=sigma)))

#sensitivity of n(0,100) slightly closer to 0 est and slightly smaller CrI, opposite for n(0,10000)
qor_convergence <- convergence(chains=4,imps=15,mod=qor_mod) %>% bind_rows()
test <- loo(qor_mod)
summary(qor_mod)

#get the CrI and Pr(Sup) from the models
qorh <- hypothesis(qor_mod,c("treatment1 > 0",
                                 "treatment1 + redcap_event_name.factor3monthfup:treatment1 > 0",
                                 "treatment1 + redcap_event_name.factorAdmission:treatment1 > 0"),
                   alpha=0.025)[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Hypothesis,Estimate,Post.Prob,CI.Lower,CI.Upper) %>%
  mutate(redcap_event_name.factor = case_when(grepl("3month",Hypothesis) ~ "3 month fup",
                                              grepl("Admission",Hypothesis) ~ "Admission",
                          .default="1 month fup"),
         MD = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(Estimate,2))," (", round(CI.Lower,2),", ",round(CI.Upper,2),")"))

#get the crude measures and combine
qor_res <- br_p2 %>% 
  group_by(redcap_event_name.factor,treatment) %>% 
  summarise(qor_tot = paste0(round(mean(qor_tot,na.rm=T),2)," (",sum(!is.na(qor_tot)),", ",round(sd(qor_tot,na.rm=T),2),")")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=redcap_event_name.factor,names_from=treatment,values_from=qor_tot) %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor != "Baseline") %>%
  merge(qorh,by="redcap_event_name.factor")

saveRDS(qor_res,here("Output","br_p2_qor.RDS"))

```


## Health service utilisation (90 days)

```{r}

cost_imp <- br_p2_imp %>% mutate(cost = round(services_total_cost,0))
cost_split <- split(x=cost_imp,f=cost_imp$.imp)

cost <- brm_multiple(services_total_cost ~ treatment + surgery_final,
    data=br_p2_split,
    family = skew_normal,iter=14000,seed=46137112,
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
    prior = c(prior(normal(0,1000)),
              prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))

costh <- hypothesis(cost,c("treatment1 < 0"),
                   alpha=0.025)[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Hypothesis,Estimate,Post.Prob,CI.Lower,CI.Upper) %>%
  mutate(MD = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(Estimate,2))," (", round(CI.Lower,2),", ",round(CI.Upper,2),")"))
#get the crude measures and combine
cost_res <- br_p2 %>% 
  group_by(treatment,redcap_event_name.factor) %>% 
  summarise(services_total_cost = paste0(round(mean(services_total_cost,na.rm=T),2)," (",sum(!is.na(services_total_cost)),
                                         ", ",round(sd(services_total_cost,na.rm=T),2),")")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols=redcap_event_name.factor,names_from=treatment,values_from=services_total_cost) %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor == "3 month fup") %>%
  merge(costh)

saveRDS(cost_res,here("Output","br_p2_cost.RDS"))

```

## ED presentations

```{r}

ed_mod <- brm(ed_presentations_3mo ~ surgery_type.factor + treatment,data=br_p2,
              family=bernoulli,iter=12000,seed=46137112,
              prior = c(prior(normal(0,10),class="b"),
                        prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))

#sensitivity n(0,1) difference towards the null, less change in n(0,100) away from null
summary(ed_mod)

ed_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(ed_mod)[3,3:4]
edh <- hypothesis(ed_mod,"treatment1 < 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
edor <- merge(ed_ci,edh) %>%
  mutate(OR = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(exp(Estimate),2))," (", round(exp(CI_low),2),", ",round(exp(CI_high),2),")"))

ed_res <- br_p2 %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor == "3 month fup") %>%
  summarise(ed_presentations_3mo = paste0(sum(ed_presentations_3mo)," / ",n()," (",round(sum(ed_presentations_3mo)/n()*100,2),"%)")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=treatment,values_from=ed_presentations_3mo) %>%
  merge(edor)

saveRDS(ed_res,here("Output","ed_res.RDS"))
```

## Readmissions

```{r}
read_mod <- brm(admissions_3mo ~ surgery_type.factor + treatment,data=br_p2,
              family=bernoulli,iter=12000,seed=46137112,
              prior = c(prior(normal(0,10),class="b"),
                        prior(student_t(3,0,100),class=Intercept)))
#sensitivity n(0,1) towards null, much smaller CrI. n(0,100) almost identical
summary(read_mod)
read_ci <- bayestestR::hdi(read_mod)[3,3:4]
readh <- hypothesis(read_mod,"treatment1 < 0")[["hypothesis"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(Estimate,Post.Prob)
reador <- merge(read_ci,readh) %>%
  mutate(OR = paste0(sprintf("%.2f",round(exp(Estimate),2))," (", round(exp(CI_low),2),", ",round(exp(CI_high),2),")"))

read_res <- br_p2 %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  filter(redcap_event_name.factor == "3 month fup") %>%
  summarise(admissions_3mo = paste0(sum(admissions_3mo)," / ",n()," (",round(sum(admissions_3mo)/n()*100,2),"%)")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=treatment,values_from=admissions_3mo) %>%
  merge(reador)

saveRDS(read_res,here("Output","read_res.RDS"))
```

## Combine

```{r}
eortc_res <- readRDS(here("Output","br_p2_eortc.RDS")) %>% mutate(outcome = "EORTC (mean (N, SD))",v=1)
hads_res <- readRDS(here("Output","br_p2_hads.RDS")) %>% mutate(outcome = "HADS anxiety (mean (N, SD))",v=2)
qor_res <- readRDS(here("Output","br_p2_qor.RDS")) %>% mutate(outcome = "QOR (mean (N, SD))",v=3)
cost_res <- readRDS(here("Output","br_p2_cost.RDS")) %>% mutate(outcome = "Health service utilisation (mean (N, SD))",v=4)
ed_res <- readRDS(here("Output","ed_res.RDS")) %>% mutate(outcome = "ED presentation (n / N (%))",v=5)
read_res <- readRDS(here("Output","read_res.RDS")) %>% mutate(outcome = "Readmission (n / N (%))",v=6)


p2_res <- bind_rows(eortc_res,hads_res,qor_res,cost_res,ed_res,read_res) %>%
  mutate(time = factor(case_when(redcap_event_name.factor == "Baseline" ~ "Baseline",
                          redcap_event_name.factor == "Admission" ~ "2 days",
                          redcap_event_name.factor == "1 month fup" ~ "30 days",
                          redcap_event_name.factor == "3 month fup" ~ "90 days",
                          .default="90 days"),
                       levels=c("Baseline","2 days","30 days","90 days")),
         est = case_when(!is.na(MD) ~ paste0("MD = ",MD),
                         !is.na(OR) ~ paste0("OR = ",OR))) %>%
  rename(treatment = `1`,
         control = `0`) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(v,time) %>%
  dplyr::select(outcome,time,treatment,control,est,Post.Prob)

saveRDS(p2_res,here("Output","Br_p2_res.RDS"))
```
